title: Uka Compañero Ukax mä juk’a pacharuw kutt’awayxi
intro: Niyaw mä almax profetjam ch’amakan jakasïna, ukampis t’unjäwir puriyir thak ajlliwayi. Aka jakhüwix Allah-an ajllit khithatanakapat maynimp mä utan jakasipxäna ukampis iyawsäwin yant’äwipanx janiw atipt’känti. ¿Khitis aka chhaqhat masixa?
clues: Nayajj cheqapar sarnaqañatak jawsatäñar jan iyawsir jaqenak taypinwa jakayäta, janiw jupanakar uñiskti.
Nayax Allahan mä profetapampiw jaqichasirïta, ukampis janiw uka iyawsäwimp chikachasirïkti.
Kunapachatï yatiyirinakajj mä ewjjtʼampiw utajar puripjjäna ukhajja, janiw creykti.
Chachajasa chachajarojj iyawsirinakamp chika markat sarjjañapatakiw mayïna, janiw nayajj jupanak taypinkkti.
Uka castigojj markajaruw saraqanïna, nayajj jupanakamp chikaw tʼunjatäyäta.
Nayax Quran ukanx mä uñacht’äwiw jan iyawsäwit uñt’ayata, Nuh warmimp chika, Surah At-Tahrim ukan.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
